subject: Dataset exchange & sandbox routing — MAP milestones and export conditions
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@brightmart.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dataset exchange & sandbox routing — MAP milestones and export conditions

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I wanted to summarize the proposed mutual action plan (MAP) for the evaluation kit exchange and the constraints we'll need enforced on your side's sandbox environment. Please see the short milestone plan below and the attached manifest.

Quick summary (high level):
- Redwood delivers: prompt pack + evaluation manifest + delivery checklist (ephemeral license).
- BrightMart provides: dedicated sandbox routing (isolated VPC or tenant), test account, and signed MAP/SOW.

Proposed milestones:
1) Feb 28 — Redwood: initial promptpack and manifest published to shared Drive (ephemeral access link) [Attachment: eval_manifest.csv, promptpack_v1.zip]
2) Mar 2 — BrightMart: confirm sandbox routing (VPC peering details or tenant ID) and set up test accounts
3) Mar 9 — Joint runbook: smoke tests + acceptance criteria executed (sample pass/fail matrix)
4) Mar 16 — Takedown window begins (30-day ephemeral use); Redwood removes any shared access and triggers asset destruction checklist

Export/usage constraints (we need these enforced):
- Dataset and prompt pack are provided for evaluation only; no redistribution, no external sharing, and no inclusion in training datasets.
- Access is ephemeral: all asset URLs expire and credentials revoked on takedown date above.
- Logging & audit: BrightMart agrees to retain access logs for 90 days and provide redacted samples on request for compliance review.

Attachments included: eval_manifest.csv, promptpack_v1.zip.

Next steps for you: confirm that procurement will sign the MAP/SOW lane we discussed and confirm which sandbox option you prefer (VPC peering OR isolated tenant). If you want, I can drop an SOW draft into the HubSpot deal record for signature.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: eval_manifest.csv]
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@brightmart.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightmart.com, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 14:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Dataset exchange & sandbox routing — MAP milestones and export conditions

Vivek —

Appreciate the clear plan. Procurement copied here; they're the ones who will review legal language on the MAP/SOW. A few quick questions from our side:

1) For the "no training" clause, procurement will ask for a short attestation template we can use internally. Can Redwood provide a one-paragraph attestation BrightMart can use when we circulate to the infra team?
2) For sandbox routing — we prefer VPC peering for this pilot. I'll confirm the VPC CIDR and owner contact by Monday.
3) Is the 30-day ephemeral window fixed, or can we request an extension for another 30 days if we need more time for acceptance tests?

Also, please put the SOW draft into the HubSpot deal and mark the lines Redwood needs countersigned.

Thanks —
Sarah Nguyen
Director, ML Ops | BrightMart

Sarah —

Thanks, and answered inline below. I uploaded a short MAP draft and a preliminary SOW to the HubSpot deal and the Drive folder (links in metadata). Included a one-paragraph attestation template you can paste into internal approvals.

Attestation template (for BrightMart):
"BrightMart certifies that the evaluation assets provided by Redwood Inference will be used solely for the purposes of evaluation under the mutual action plan dated Feb 27, 2027. BrightMart will not use the assets to train models, will not redistribute the assets, and will enforce access controls and audit logging as agreed."

Regarding the 30-day window: we generally default to 30 days for ephemeral evaluation. Requests for extension are common — please flag during acceptance testing and we can approve a single 30-day extension (mutual written agreement required).

Operational notes for infra (cc Priyom & Marissa):
- Priyom: please attach the MAP_20270227.pdf and SOW_draft.docx to the HubSpot deal and enable request-signature via our DocuSign integration.
- Marissa: once Sarah confirms the VPC CIDR, coordinate the peering handoff and provide a short runbook with the test account credentials (ephemeral).

I flagged the HubSpot task (deal BM-2027-042) and set a reminder for Mar 1 to verify peering.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
